_note: Keyed by class id, so the order of the model's outputs does not matter here. The order comes from paddy_model/class_names.json. The advice lines are generic cultural practices only (no chemical names or doses), matching the Crop Health Agent design. Replace them with the KAU-sourced Generic Treatment Protocol table when it is ready.

bacterial_leaf_blight.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
advice: Avoid excess nitrogen fertiliser.
Keep drainage good and avoid long periods of standing water.
Remove infected stubble and weeds around the field.
Use clean, certified seed next season.

bacterial_leaf_streak.name: Bacterial Leaf Streak
advice: Avoid excess nitrogen fertiliser.
Control weeds and volunteer rice on the bunds.
Do not let water flow from infected plots into healthy ones.
Use clean, certified seed next season.

bacterial_panicle_blight.name: Bacterial Panicle Blight
advice: Avoid excess nitrogen and very dense sowing.
Use healthy, certified seed.
Avoid water stress around flowering.
Note which plots are affected so you can compare next season.

blast.name: Rice Blast
advice: Apply nitrogen in split doses and avoid excess.
Keep the field evenly irrigated and avoid water stress.
Remove infected residue and weeds that can carry the disease.
Choose blast-tolerant varieties next season.

brown_spot.name: Brown Spot
advice: Correct nutrient shortages with balanced fertilisation, especially potassium.
Avoid water stress.
Use healthy seed and destroy infected residue.

dead_heart.name: Dead Heart (stem borer damage)
advice: Remove and destroy affected tillers early.
Avoid excess nitrogen and late planting.
Destroy stubble after harvest.
Check neighbouring plots for the same symptom.

downy_mildew.name: Downy Mildew
advice: Improve drainage and avoid long periods of wet leaves.
Avoid dense planting.
Remove and destroy infected plants.
Use certified seed.

hispa.name: Rice Hispa
advice: Clip and destroy leaf tips where the beetle larvae are feeding.
Keep the bunds free of weeds.
Avoid excess nitrogen.
Check nearby plots, because hispa spreads between fields.

normal.name: Healthy Leaf
advice: No disease found. Keep checking your plants every few days.

tungro.name: Tungro
advice: Remove and destroy infected plants early.
Control weeds and plant at the same time as your neighbours.
Watch for green leafhoppers, which carry the virus.
Choose tungro-tolerant varieties next season.
